description: This source file defines a set of asynchronous command functions for a financial data router, handling various fundamental analysis endpoints such as balance sheets, income statements, financial ratios, and corporate disclosures. It registers commands with a router, each associated with specific financial data retrieval tasks, utilizing models and examples. The functions invoke an OBBject class method to perform asynchronous queries based on local parameters.
